name: Certified GDN dot omission preparation
model_or_reference: Original GB10 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B layer0/layer1 q7169 captures; no model loaded

capture_admission_audit.scope: Full original layer0/layer1 WH admission for both residual consumers, complete admitted unscaled residuals compared with GB10 capture, independent original dot samples and output reconstruction. Same source norm helper intended for GPU; no throughput conclusion.

earlier_narrow_domain_audit.scope: Full original layer0/layer1 WH admission for both residual consumers, complete admitted unscaled residuals compared with GB10 capture, independent original dot samples and output reconstruction. Same source norm helper intended for GPU; no throughput conclusion.
earlier_narrow_domain_audit.decision: The first absolute bound excluded many small captured operands. The final certificate uses upward normal proxies for subnormals and a minimum-normal product floor. Original output and dot checks are repeated on the broader domain.

compact_matrix_admission_prior.scope: Deterministic sampled WH and QH dots from original layer0/layer1 checkpoints; exact group admission and original raw carry comparison only. No new kernel or timing conclusion.
compact_matrix_admission_prior.decision: Few entire captured K128 dots are certified by the existing compact integer matrix primitive. This observation does not establish hardware speed or prohibit another design; the current candidate instead omits dots at proven consumers.

record.scope: Full original layer0/layer1 WH admission for both residual consumers, complete admitted unscaled residuals compared with GB10 capture, independent original dot samples and output reconstruction. Same source norm helper intended for GPU; no throughput conclusion.

prepared_native_build.prerequisite_policy: Require completed local and remote process/host cleanup, regardless of model outcome. No native build or GPU action while the current original256k owner is active.

scope: The actual norm certificate and compacted exact-replay state/output bodies pass host numerical and ownership checks. Captured admission counts cover both residual consumers and sampled output consumers; independent original dots and complete sampled outputs match the captured GB10 boundary. The isolated 26-input native fixture is prepared and its PowerShell grammar passes. Native safety, complete component timing and real-model correctness/performance are still unrun. No runtime dispatcher, package, guard or acceptance threshold changes.
